doc: Longitude and latitude (rad) of the texel centers of a 16x8 north-up grid: column 0 at -pi + pi/16, row 0 at pi/2 - pi/16, centers at (i + 0.5) steps. Closed-form float64: rtol 1e-9, atol 1e-12 (the middle columns sit at +-pi/W, a difference of two numbers near pi, so an absolute floor is needed).
